de40_watch.topic: Watch-list re-checks, status as of 28 October 2026

claims.text: No. 25-828 GEO Group v. Nwauzor: petition filed 9 Jan 2026; CVSG 18 May 2026; US amicus brief 15 Sep 2026; supplemental briefs 29 Sep 2026; distributed 7 Oct 2026 for the conference of 6 Nov 2026; no order on the petition as of 28 Oct 2026
No. 26A90: Justice Alito extended Khalil's time to petition for certiorari to 21 Sep 2026 (granted 27 Jul) and then to 19 Oct 2026 (granted 17 Sep 2026); docket shows linked case 26-530

ABC 19 Oct 2026: Khalil appealed to the Supreme Court after a divided appeals court held he could not litigate his claims before a judge until immigration proceedings end; justices likely to consider the petition at a private conference in January; released from custody pending the petition; not charged with any crime; separate challenge pending in the Fifth Circuit
13 Oct 2026: Supreme Court agreed to hear CREW's case on whether DOGE is subject to FOIA; administration argues DOGE was a presidential advisory body; no argument date given in the report

Law-firm orders appeal: Jenner & Block v. DOJ, No. 25-5265 (D.C. Cir.), argument set for 14 May 2026; panel Pillard, Srinivasan, Rao; the panel appeared inclined to keep the orders blocked; four district judges (Howell, Leon, Bates, AliKhan) had struck the orders down; no decision found as of 28 Oct 2026

15 Jun 2026: D.C. Circuit granted a stay pending appeal of the injunction against Albanese's sanctions; the court 'did not rule on whether the sanctions are ultimately lawful'; no merits schedule reported

AAUP v. Rubio: government appealed 9 Feb 2026 (First Circuit Nos. 26-1141, 26-1195 incl. plaintiffs' cross-appeal 24 Feb); on 11 Mar 2026 the district court denied most of the stay motion, staying only the monetary part of the sanctions relief
PEER v. Trump (D. Md.): stay lifted 17 Feb 2026; motion to dismiss and motion to file second amended complaint pending; no preliminary injunction or summary-judgment motion shown

Trump to TIME (reported 1 Oct 2026), asked about an emergency before the midterms: 'I don't rule anything out or in. We'll see.' On the Insurrection Act: 'No, I've never used it. I could use it.' No invocation or election-related deployment reported

Biometric Update 31 Aug 2026: Kyle Schutt acting OBIM director and acting DHS CIO; HART managed through the CIO's office and scheduled to reach initial operational capability no later than September 2026
